'''Gisseran''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Gisseran acquired a [[Gisseran's memento|memento]] from the [[invasion of Taris]], but they were forced to seek outside help when they discovered the memento had been stolen.

==Behind the scenes==
At a later update of the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the crew-mission description was changed and featured them as [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] instead of Moff.<ref name="Memento" />
